name: @olai/surface
//exports: One door, because there is one kind of thing here: the DECLARATION. `./holding` was a second subpath while this package also held a serving-side seam — the only module here that reached for `@kolu/surface/server`, kept out of the index because the index is what the browser bundles. That seam is a member of `CollectionHandlerDeps` upstream now (`holders`), so the module is gone and the door with it.
//dependencies: @olai/format for the domain's wire vocabulary, and @olai/acp's `./wire` subpath for the protocol's — the surface is a declaration, and every olai type on the wire is owned by the package that speaks it and re-exported here (RepoState through format, the ask shapes through acp). The two APPLIANCE slices are named the same way and for the same ruling — @olai/kolu-client and @olai/odu-client each hold their own wire vocabulary and their own member declarations, which this spec SPREADS (`koluMembers`, `oduMembers`) and re-exports, so nothing kolu- or odu-named lives in the package every browser bundles. @kolu/surface is absent on purpose: it is hydrated from the Nix store rather than installed from bun.lock, so it is declared once for the whole tree in the root package.json (see bunfig.toml).
